scenes.basis: 9:1 "He called the twelve together" - the commissioning discourse names no place; it follows the unnamed city of 8:40-56
9:7 "Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him" - Herod's court is not named
9:10 "He took them, and withdrew apart to a desert region of a city called Bethsaida"
9:18 "As he was praying alone, the disciples were with him" - no place is named; the confession and passion prediction follow the Bethsaida scene
9:28 "he took with him Peter, John, and James, and went up onto the mountain to pray" - the mountain of the transfiguration is not named
9:37 "On the next day, when they had come down from the mountain, a great multitude met him" - no place is named for the healing and the discourses of 9:44-50
9:52 "entered into a village of the Samaritans"
9:57 "As they went on the way, a certain man said to him" - the road inherits the Samaritan journey of 9:52
